findings.summary: Glimmer (full) outperforms Trellis-RE on all three test sets, with F1 gains of 3.4 points on Hollin-DocRE (65.2 vs 61.8), 3.6 points on Saltmarsh-Bio (55.9 vs 52.3), and 1.1 points on Wistmoor-News (71.1 vs 70.0).
findings.scope: All three test sets (Hollin-DocRE, Saltmarsh-Bio, Wistmoor-News), relation F1 (%), mean over 3 seeds.
findings.caveats: No statistical tests reported; differences are descriptive only.

findings.summary: The evidence-gating module contributes to performance on the in-domain and biomedical sets: removing it lowers F1 from 65.2 to 63.0 on Hollin-DocRE and from 55.9 to 54.1 on Saltmarsh-Bio, but on Wistmoor-News removing it raises F1 from 71.1 to 72.4, indicating a mixed effect across domains.
findings.scope: Ablation comparison on all three test sets, relation F1 (%), mean over 3 seeds.
findings.caveats: No statistical tests reported; the Wistmoor-News result is adverse to the module's benefit.

sentences.text: Glimmer (full) achieves higher relation F1 than Trellis-RE on all three test sets, with gains of 3.4 points on Hollin-DocRE (65.2 vs 61.8), 3.6 points on Saltmarsh-Bio (55.9 vs 52.3), and 1.1 points on Wistmoor-News (71.1 vs 70.0).

The ablation shows that removing the evidence-gating module decreases F1 on Hollin-DocRE (65.2 to 63.0) and Saltmarsh-Bio (55.9 to 54.1), but increases F1 on Wistmoor-News (71.1 to 72.4), indicating a mixed effect across domains.
These results are descriptive only, as no statistical tests were reported.
